description: Combined owner-reported capture/playback checklist on Brave and a microphone connected to PC: five first observations plus three follow-up observations. Earlier report stays unchanged. This completes the requested capture/playback smoke scope, not all privacy/lifecycle subclaims, model selection or product release.
first_report_verbatim: Brave, microphone cắm vào PC. Nghe rõ, đủ câu, không rè. Dừng/Hủy/Escape/chuyển tab đều tắt thu.
followup_report_verbatim:
1. Mở/reload trang: microphone không tự thu. đạt
2. Từ chối quyền microphone: hiện lỗi, không thu âm. đạt
3. Ghi quá 30 giây: tự dừng thu. đạt

reported_observations.observation: Clear, complete sentence and no audible distortion reported.
Capture stops after Cancel; preview discard not separately reported.
Capture stops after Escape; audio discard not separately reported.
Capture stops after switching tab; behavior on returning not separately reported.
Opening/reloading the page does not start microphone capture.
Denying microphone permission shows an error and does not capture.
Capture stops automatically at the30second limit as reported; exact elapsed time not independently measured.
